name: Nuclear
description: Tauri updater, minisign signature vs pinned key (independent of OS signing); auto-install opt-in. NOTE: separate plugin marketplace runs jsdelivr/GitHub zips via new Function() with no verification — a content-as-code RCE surface beside the safe updater.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The retained source shows a configured trust root and an updater invocation that routes candidate artifacts through the project verifier before installation, consistent with the recorded narrow A classification.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release/build configuration and historical study version may differ.
